comments.content: Setting a deprecated field to a single space " " instead of null is a workaround that may cause confusion. Consider removing the field entirely or keeping it nullable with null as default. If DB constraints require non-null, add a comment explaining why a space is used.

The fallback logic for input filling is complex and catches generic Exception. Consider: 1) Using more specific exception types (e.g., PlaywrightException). 2) Adding logging for each fallback attempt to aid debugging. 3) The second fill("") in the first catch block seems redundant after the first fill("") succeeded.

The debug marker injection uses a hardcoded ID '__move_click_marker__'. If multiple clicks happen concurrently, this could cause conflicts. Consider using a unique ID per invocation (e.g., UUID or timestamp). Also, the scroll calculation assumes the target should be centered; this may not be desired for all cases (e.g., clicking near edges).

Auto-prefixing 'https://' for URLs without a scheme is a reasonable UX improvement, but it may hide user errors (e.g., typo in 'http://'). Consider logging a warning when this auto-correction occurs, or at least documenting the behavior clearly.
